ValidationRule.description: Customer ID is required and must be related to the Case's Account in SFDC for certain Cases. (Excludes Customer ID A5000 and A7000)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (($RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: SKP New Customer Setup' ||$RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: Tech Services New Customer Setup' || $RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: DMS') && NOT(ISBLANK( Setup_Complete_Date__c) ) && ISBLANK(Customer_ID__c)) || ( ($RecordType.Name == 'Issue' || $RecordType.Name == 'Task' || $RecordType.Name == 'Task Request' ) && Not(isblank(Customer_ID__c)) && Not(isblank( Account.Id )) && Customer_ID__r.IM_Account__r.Id <> Account.Id )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Customer ID is required and must be related to the Case's Account in SFDC except for NCSP which can be related to the IMGA.
